name: AI Learning Management System
description: Enterprise-scale Learning Management System with multi-tenant architecture supporting super-admin, organizations, branches, schools, parents, and students. Features AI chatbot tutor with voice interaction (STT/TTS), personalized learning paths generated from curriculum, adaptive quiz generation, and multi-agent workflows.
intro: Multi-tenant AI-powered LMS with voice-enabled tutoring and adaptive learning paths. Built for enterprise scale with real-time voice interaction and dynamic curriculum generation.
problem_solved: Traditional LMS platforms lack intelligent adaptation. LMS solves this with AI-driven personalized learning paths, voice-enabled tutoring, and multi-agent workflows that adapt to each student's performance.
technical_details:
## Architecture

Multi-tenant Django backend with Pinecone vector DB for curriculum embeddings.

## Key Features

- AI chatbot tutor with STT/TTS voice interaction
- Adaptive learning paths based on quiz performance
- Multi-agent workflows for synchronized AI operations
- Production-ready with real-time voice interaction

name: Voice Command ML Pipeline
description: ML pipeline converting voice commands to mobile app actions. Fine-tuned 30MB Vosk model with custom phoneme mappings to recognize commands like 'open camera' or 'take photo'. Complete audio preprocessing pipeline with noise removal, voice cleaning, transcription, and action mapping.
intro: Fine-tuned voice recognition model for mobile app action control. Implements custom phoneme-to-word mapping for enhanced accuracy.
problem_solved: Standard voice recognition models are too large for mobile and lack domain-specific command accuracy. ActionFlow solves this with a fine-tuned 30MB model using custom phoneme mapping.
technical_details:
## Pipeline

Audio Input → Noise Removal → Voice Cleaning → Vosk Transcription → Phoneme Mapping → Action Matching

## Key Features

- Fine-tuned 30MB Vosk model
- Custom phoneme-to-word mapping
- Similarity scoring for action matching
- Optimized for mobile deployment

name: QueryClip - Video RAG System
description: A RAG video chatbot to deliver accurate, context-aware answers. Users can upload videos, which are split into chunks and embedded into a vector database. When a question is asked, the chatbot retrieves relevant chunks using similarity search and generates response with timestamp-accurate moment retrieval.
intro: AI-powered video analysis chatbot enabling timestamp-accurate moment retrieval using Whisper, ChromaDB, and multi-provider LLM fallback.
problem_solved: Users struggled to find specific information within long video content, requiring manual scrubbing and watching entire videos.
technical_details:
## Architecture

Built using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pattern for intelligent video content analysis.

## Key Features

- Audio extraction and intelligent chunking
- Embedding generation with semantic retrieval
- Multi-provider LLM fallback for reliability
- Timestamp-accurate moment retrieval

name: Workday Integration Platform
description: Automation platform connecting LLM agents to Workday via SOAP/REST APIs. Users query natural language chatbot, agent performs Workday operations (hiring, onboarding, client search), returns results. Zero Workday knowledge required for end users.
intro: LLM agents automating Workday HR operations through natural language. Zero training required for users.
problem_solved: Workday HR operations require specialized knowledge and training. This platform lets anyone perform complex HR workflows through simple natural language queries.
technical_details:
## Architecture

LLM agent orchestration layer connecting to Workday SOAP/REST APIs

## Key Features

- Natural language Workday control
- Automated hiring and onboarding workflows
- Client search and management
- Zero-training required for users

name: Agency Management Backend
description: Full backend architecture for multi-portal agency management platform. 4-layer system: super-admin portal, agent portal, agency portal, client portal. Complete database design, authentication with role-based access control, CRUD operations, and dashboard analytics.
intro: Complete Django backend for 4-tier agency management system with role-based access control and dashboard analytics.
problem_solved: Multi-tier agency management requires complex role-based access and separate portal experiences. Travel Agency provides a unified backend supporting four distinct user tiers.
technical_details:
## Architecture

4-tier portal system with role-based access control

## Key Features

- Super-admin, agent, agency, and client portals
- Complete authentication system
- Dashboard analytics for each tier
- Production deployment

name: Sentient Edge - Real Estate Insights Platform
description: Real-time insights platform for real estate investment decisions. Aggregates structured and unstructured data from social media, crime databases, amenity APIs, and heatmaps. Uses fine-tuned LLMs for humanized analysis with investment impact assessment and listing evaluation.
intro: Final Year Project: Real-time real estate insights platform aggregating multi-source data with AI-powered humanized analysis for investment decisions.
problem_solved: Real estate investors lack centralized, AI-analyzed data from multiple sources. Sentient Edge aggregates and analyzes data to provide actionable investment insights.
technical_details:
## Architecture

Multi-source data aggregation with fine-tuned LLM analysis layer

## Key Features

- Real-time data from social media, crime DBs, amenity APIs
- AI-powered humanized insights
- Investment impact assessment
- Area environment analysis and heatmaps

name: Enterprise RAG Chatbot for Financial Analysis
description: AI-based chatbot designed for financial document analysis and wealth management support. Combines document retrieval with AI models for due diligence, risk checks, and investment performance analysis using hybrid retrieval with Pinecone and BM25.
intro: Enterprise-grade RAG chatbot for financial document analysis with hybrid retrieval and automated KPI extraction.
problem_solved: Financial analysis requires going through long reports and complex spreadsheets. This automates document reading, duplicate detection, metric calculation, and analysis summary generation.
technical_details:
## Retrieval System

Hybrid retriever with Pinecone vector DB and BM25 keyword scoring

## Financial Tools

IRR, NPV, TVPI, DPI calculations, stress tests, peer comparison

## Features

- Document upload and duplicate detection
- Financial metric extraction
- Visual dashboards for KPIs

name: AI Recipe Assistant
description: Smart AI-powered web application that helps users discover, plan, and customize recipes using artificial intelligence. Features personalized meal suggestions, nutrition insights, voice-controlled cooking assistance, and OCR-based recipe import.
intro: AI Recipe Assistant combines Next.js 15, Groq AI, and voice recognition for a modern cooking experience with OCR recipe import.
problem_solved: Finding recipes matching personal preferences and dietary needs is time-consuming. This app provides AI-powered suggestions, intelligent meal planning, and instant cooking assistance.
technical_details:
## Architecture

Next.js 15 with React 19, Groq LLM API (llama3-8b-8192)

## Key Features

- Voice recognition with multi-language support
- OCR recipe import via Tesseract.js
- Step-by-step voice-guided cooking
- Nutrition calculator and meal planning

name: LiveKit Voice Agent - Outbound Call System
description: Voice-based AI calling system using Twilio and LiveKit for real-time audio streaming. Speech recognition via Deepgram, response generation with Groq LLM, and voice output via ElevenLabs for automated phone conversations.
intro: AI-powered outbound calling system with real-time voice interaction using LiveKit, Deepgram STT, and ElevenLabs TTS.
problem_solved: Businesses spend time and money on manual phone calls. This system automates calls with an AI agent that speaks, listens, and responds naturally.
technical_details:
## Voice Workflow

Live speech → Deepgram STT → Groq LLM → ElevenLabs TTS

## Features

- Outbound call initiation and management
- Real-time audio streaming via LiveKit
- Session management and cleanup

name: AI E-commerce Chatbot
description: Production chatbot for e-commerce product search processing 1000+ products. Uses OpenAI embeddings, GPT-3.5, ChromaDB. Achieved 95% search accuracy, 0.8s response time, 60% improvement in recommendations.
intro: Production RAG chatbot with 95% search accuracy and 0.8s response time for e-commerce product discovery.
problem_solved: Traditional search in e-commerce fails to understand user intent. This chatbot uses semantic search and NLP for intelligent product recommendations.
technical_details:
## NLP Pipeline

- Semantic search using OpenAI embeddings
- Location-aware recommendations
- Vector similarity matching with ChromaDB

## Results

- 95% search accuracy
- 0.8s response time
- 60% better recommendations

name: DeepFetch - RAG Chatbot
description: AI chatbot answering questions using stored documents and Mistral-7B. Supports PDF, Word, and Markdown processing with intelligent chunking, ChromaDB vector storage, and contextual response generation.
intro: RAG-based AI chatbot with document processing pipeline and Mistral-7B response generation.
problem_solved: Finding answers in large document collections is tedious. DeepFetch provides instant AI-powered answers from any document format.
technical_details:
## Document Pipeline

- Multi-format support (PDF, Word, Markdown)
- Intelligent text chunking
- ChromaDB vector embedding and retrieval
- Mistral-7B response generation

name: Magnum-Opsem E-commerce Platform
description: Fully customizable e-commerce platform where users customize themes, manage content via admin dashboard, and publish on custom domains. Features dynamic customization, location-based ordering, and multi-tenant architecture.
intro: Dynamic e-commerce platform-as-a-service with advanced customization and location-aware services.
problem_solved: Traditional e-commerce solutions lack flexibility for businesses needing location-based features and extensive UI customization.
technical_details:
## Architecture

- React.js with Redux state management
- Express.js backend with MongoDB
- Multi-tenant architecture

## Features

- Dynamic theme customization
- Location-based ordering
- Admin dashboard
- 30% operational efficiency improvement

name: EcoCommute - Carpooling Platform
description: Web-based carpooling platform for university communities. Features gender-specific ride options for safety, route optimization, flexible scheduling, ride matching, and reward system encouraging sustainability.
intro: University carpooling solution for sustainable transportation with safety-first features.
problem_solved: University campuses face parking congestion, traffic, and high carbon emissions from individual commuting.
technical_details:
## Features

- Gender-specific ride options
- Route optimization and matching
- Reward system for sustainability
- 25% satisfaction improvement

name: Medical Conversation Analysis Tool
description: NLP-powered tool for processing and analyzing medical conversations between doctors and patients. Leverages Hugging Face models for transcription, speaker classification, and automated summarization.
intro: NLP tool for medical conversation analysis with speaker classification and automated summarization.
problem_solved: Medical professionals need efficient ways to document and analyze patient conversations.
technical_details:
## NLP Features

- Audio transcription with Whisper
- Speaker role classification
- Automated conversation summarization
- Medical terminology recognition

name: Tetris in Assembly Language

intro: Classic Tetris game implemented in x86 8088 Assembly demonstrating low-level programming proficiency.
problem_solved: Low-level game programming demonstration with direct hardware manipulation.
technical_details:
## Implementation

- Assembly 8088 architecture
- Classic Tetris mechanics
- Direct hardware manipulation
- Score tracking and progressive difficulty
